Michael Lind

About the author

Michael Lind is the author of more than a dozen books about U.S. political and economic history, politics and foreign policy. He has explained and defended the tradition of American democratic nationalism in The New Class War: Saving Democracy from the Managerial Elite (2023), Land of Promise: An Economic History of the United States (2012), The American Way of Strategy (2006), What Lincoln Believed (2005), Hamilton's Republic (1997), and The Next American Nation (1995).
